description: Fifth scenario split, written blind on 7 September 2026 before Phase 1A existed, before the category classifier or inventory generator produced any output, and before the gap-anchored admission rule was evaluated. Differences from earlier splits: no record carries a category the pipeline can read; `category_truth` and `ambient_truth` are scoring labels only. All records are written as conditional and the real activation policy decides which become ambient. One scoped preference and one unsafe preference test that promotion stays narrow. The accepted thresholds and final results are recorded in docs/usefulness-gate.md and docs/acceptance-report.md.
